paragraphs: Duett is a referral platform for care coordinators who need to identify providers for care plans. The company says it is also a way for providers to grow their business and for individuals to choose their care.
The site frames the result as going from care plan to referral in hours rather than days. One stated benefit is expanding a provider network. Another is turning insights into action.

The rest of the homepage is addressed to people finding services for their clients. Its main call to action is to schedule a demo. Testimonials on the page describe it helping patients and their families get services.
